column1: # Apple M1 Ultra (Mac13,2), macOS 27.0 (26A428), captured 2026-09-20 by the ioreport_energy_diagnostics test, which enumerates the whole "Energy Model" group with IOReportCopyChannelsInGroup rather than sampling the filtered all-smi subscription: every channel as name<TAB>unit, in enumeration order. All 321 channels had an empty subgroup. The 130 DTL names (ECPUDTL*, PCPUDTL*, PCPU1DTL*) each appear twice, with no DIE_ prefix to tell the two apart, and are kept as enumerated.
